tonight_incubator.brief: The current email scanner (thunderbird_email_intel.py) is dead — killed 2026-06-28. Research architectures for a zero-model or free-model email processing pipeline. Requirements: (1) alert Commander via Telegram when D2M-relevant email arrives, (2) NO paid model calls in the background loop, (3) rule-based classification first (sender whitelist, subject keywords), (4) optional on-demand AI processing triggered manually by Commander. Research: Gmail watch push notifications vs polling, filter-first vs classify-first, sender-based routing. Deliverable: design doc + recommended implementation.
search_angles: Gmail push notifications vs polling for real-time alerts
Zero-token email alerting pipelines open source 2025-2026
Lightweight email triage architectures for small business
Sender whitelist + keyword filter patterns Gmail API Python
